text:
This run cannot establish whether any price choice meets your stated churn safeguard, so no option can be put forward.

- The comparison was otherwise moderately robust, but “monthly churn under 4%” was not scored: the model produces a change in churn, not a churn rate on the same scale as the 4% limit.
- The £20k MRR threshold also lacks a current MRR baseline/frame, and Non‑Pro MRR defaulted to zero. Those make target attainment unreliable.
- The provisional inputs include Olumi’s estimates for monthly churn and feature value perception; they are assumptions, not measurements.

The key next reasoning step is to define the churn limit in terms the model can measure.
